messages:
sec-bot: Alert: unusual KMS Decrypt spike for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01 - ~200 decrypts in 5m. Source hints: role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ci-runner. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/kms-decrypts?from=-5m
Alex R.: I see the alert, pulling CloudTrail and KMS metrics now.
Jamie L.: Priya can you take IC? sounds like potential creds misuse.
Priya S.: I’ll IC. Roles: Mike -> containment (revoke/patch IAM), Alex -> triage/evidence, Jamie -> comms/legal. Keep messages short and post actions.
Mike T.: On it. First quick step: detach the suspicious policy and disable assume role in trust policy. Running aws iam update-assume-role-policy...
Mike T.: Command snippet: ```aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name ci-runner --policy-document file://deny-assume.json```
Mike T.: Done. IAM trust patched at 1717654370.
Alex R.: CloudTrail shows decrypts started at 2024-04-03T14:12:05Z, all from same assumed role session: sessionTokenId=sts::ASIA...; pod annotation points to namespace proj-ci runner-sa.
Alex R.: Kube mapping: proj-ci/runner-sa -> aws-iam-role ci-runner (IRSA). Found a recent pipeline run 2024-04-03T14:10 that had elevated perms. Saving logs: /tmp/inc-1717654321/cloudtrail.log (uploaded to secure vault).
Priya S.: Good containment step. Next: rotate CMK key policy to remove that principal, enable full CloudTrail encryption logging and increase retention to 90d. Also enable synchronous alerting for decrypt-rate > 10/min.
Jamie L.: Notifying security@, legal@, and customer-ops. Draft sent in #announcements-private. No customer-facing impact identified so far.
sec-bot: Audit export started -> s3://redwood-security-audit/kms/2024/04/03/ (logs should appear in ~2m) 1717654440
Mike T.: Also removed clusterrolebinding that allowed SA to escalate: ```kubectl delete clusterrolebinding runner-elevate-binding -n proj-ci``` -> deleted at 1717654475.
Alex R.: After IAM patch and CRB removal, decrypt traffic dropped to baseline. Confirming with Grafana now.
Alex R.: Evidence summary: CloudTrail files x3, kube audit x2, CI pipeline logs. Uploaded archive to vault path: vault://incidents/1717654321.tar.gz.
Priya S.: Action items for follow-up (assigning now): rotate CMK + audit key policy (SEC-234), add alert & anomaly rule for decrypt spikes (SEC-235), prevent SA->role mapping in onboarding automation (SEC-236), write short playbook for quick role revoke (SEC-237).
Jamie L.: Created tickets and assigned owners. I'll update incident doc: https://wiki.internal/incidents/1717654321
Priya S.: Prepare timeline and postmortem. We'll hand off to night oncall Sam at 02:00 UTC. Handoff checklist: what we changed, evidence locations, open tickets, and watchlist.
Mike T.: Confirmed IAM change is reversible but locked down. Leaving a runbook note with commands and rollback steps in the incident doc.
Jamie L.: Legal wants retention confirmation for audit logs; I updated SEC-235 to include retention SLA.
sec-bot: Incident transitioned to maintenance mode. Watchlist alerts now set. Handoff to Sam scheduled 1717654700
Priya S.: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if new activity shows. Closing active coordination channel but keeping thread pinned to incident doc.
